m6_transfer.revision_diff_and_validity_reason: Six owner-approved actual replacements from Oct15 100: Irenicus's Vile Duplication for Brainstorm, Double Vision for Kess, Swan Song for Arcane Denial, Toxic Deluge for Blasphemous Act, Chrome Mox for Izzet Signet and Ancient Tomb for Haunted Ridge. Whole-source copy/choice/voting support changes stack interaction, acceleration and old flexibility. Exact new SHA verified with five original P0 and nine original P1 bounded positive/adversarial source-paid test cases, including an original P1 K4 implemented in m6_p0_followup despite its tier. Historical input-only I/J proof does not transfer as new independent Phase B; no full stack engine, random multiplayer win-rate or claimed global optimum.
